findings.summary: The proposal did not freeze the credential-reader remediation required by Program 014.
findings.evidence: The credential contract required presence preflight, lock-scoped access, and once-per-process loading but did not prohibit module-, class-, static-, or instance-callable credential readers or freeze the exact launcher-validation, durable attempt, process-global latch, receipt, client-construction, and transport ordering that closed Program 014 terminal-review findings.
findings.required_correction: Preserve proposal v1 and issue prospective v2 requiring no standalone callable credential reader; inline parsing only in the lock-bound loader after launcher revalidation, a create-only fsynced authority/source/predecessor-bound attempt, and process-global latch consumption; consume the latch on reservation or parse failure; persist failure or success receipt before propagation, client construction, or transport; add AST/API absence and forbidden-environment regressions.

design_review_result.proof_gap: Program 015 has no runtime, so actual lock, terminal, credential, transport, and private-root behavior remains future implementation work.

security_review_result.proof_gap: The review was static and synthetic and made no credential access, provider request, or private-root read.

scope_limit: The reviews made no credential access, provider request, private market-data read, strategy calculation, controlled or protected read, PAPER action, broker write, live action, or purchase.
required_next_action: Preserve proposal v1, issue prospective proposal v2 with the exact Program 014 credential-reader remediation and sequencing contract, add focused regressions, and obtain fresh finding-free design/correctness and defensive reviews before implementation.
